evidence.notes: Local custom metadata deploy supports a null callback and records local deployment status; callback invocation remains explicit unsupported.
CustomMetadata retrieve reads locally deployed custom metadata records.
Local deployment status can be read by deployment Id.
includeDetails controls whether the local status DTO includes component details.
String deployment ids share the local status lookup path.
The include-protected overload shares the local custom metadata retrieve path.
MetadataType.CustomMetadata drives local custom metadata retrieve.

source.content: @isTest private class MetadataOperationsCustomMetadataTest { @isTest static void deployAndRetrieveCustomMetadataLocally() { Metadata.DeployContainer container = new Metadata.DeployContainer(); Metadata.CustomMetadata item = new Metadata.CustomMetadata(); item.fullName = 'Feature.Default'; item.label = 'Default'; Metadata.CustomMetadataValue value = new Metadata.CustomMetadataValue(); value.field = 'Enabled__c'; value.value = true; item.values.add(value); container.addMetadata(item); Id deploymentId = Metadata.Operations.enqueueDeployment(container, null); Metadata.DeployResult status = Metadata.Operations.checkDeployStatus(deploymentId, true); System.assert(status.success); System.assertEquals(Metadata.DeployStatus.SUCCEEDED, status.status); System.assertEquals(null, Metadata.Operations.checkDeployStatus(deploymentId).details); String deploymentText = (String)deploymentId; System.assert(Metadata.Operations.checkDeployStatus(deploymentText).success); System.assert(Metadata.Operations.checkDeployStatus(deploymentText, false).success); List<Metadata.CustomMetadata> rows = Metadata.Operations.retrieve(Metadata.MetadataType.CustomMetadata, new List<String>{ 'Feature.Default' }); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals('Feature.Default', rows[0].fullName); System.assertEquals(true, rows[0].values[0].value); List<Metadata.CustomMetadata> rowsWithProtected = Metadata.Operations.retrieve(Metadata.MetadataType.CustomMetadata, new List<String>{ 'Feature.Default' }, true); System.assertEquals(1, rowsWithProtected.size()); } }
